user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Robotic Hydroponic Farm. A hydroponic vertical farm: stacked grow racks with rows of lettuce, tomatoes and herbs under magenta grow lights, articulated robot arms tending and harvesting, a conveyor carrying produce trays, nutrient tanks with gauges, drifting monitor drones, dripping irrigation lines, and a glass wall showing a night city outside. Style: clean agri-tech. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
